item.text: 已确认当前问题核心：分类使用了非内建的 `sticky-header`，购物车放在滚动容器内部，分类事件写法也不兼容微信小程序；视频则以非静音自动播放，容易被移动端策略拦截。我正在把这些改为内建 `scroll-view`/`image`/`video` 能力和标准事件数据传递。
两个完整输出文件已写入。现在做最后的静态核对，重点检查：购物车是否已移出滚动容器、吸顶是否改为 CSS 内建能力、微信分类事件是否通过 dataset、图片加载是否触发布局刷新，以及视频是否以静音自动播放并支持用户点击恢复声音。

<template>
  <view
    class="feed-page"
    bindtouchstart="onTouchStart"
    bindtouchmove="onTouchMove"
    bindtouchend="onTouchEnd"
    bindtouchcancel="onTouchEnd"
  >
    <scroll-view class="feed-scroll" scroll-y enable-flex>
      <view class="feed-content" data-layout-revision="{{layoutRevision}}">
        <view class="categories-wrap">
          <scroll-view class="categories-scroll" scroll-x show-scrollbar="{{false}}">
            <view class="categories">
              <text
                wx:for="{{categories}}"
                wx:key="id"
                class="{{item.id == activeCategoryId ? 'category active' : 'category'}}"
                data-category-id="{{item.id}}"
                bindtap="selectCategory"
              >{{item.name}}</text>
          </view>
          </scroll-view>
        </view>

        <view wx:for="{{products}}" wx:key="id" class="product">
          <image
            class="product-image"
            src="{{item.image}}"
            mode="widthFix"
            lazy-load
            bindload="onImageLoad"
          />
          <product-video wx:if="{{item.video}}" product="{{item}}" />
        </view>
      </view>
    </scroll-view>

    <view class="fixed-cart" bindtap="openCart">购物车 {{cartCount}}</view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    categories: [],
    products: [],
    activeCategoryId: '',
    cartCount: 2,
    layoutRevision: 0,
    dragging: false
  },
  async onLoad () {
    const { data } = await mpx.request({ url: '/api/feed' })
    this.setData({
      categories: data.categories || [],
      products: data.products || [],
      activeCategoryId: data.categories && data.categories.length ? data.categories[0].id : ''
    })
  },
  methods: {
    selectCategory (event) {
      this.setData({ activeCategoryId: event.currentTarget.dataset.categoryId })
    },
    onImageLoad () {
      // Re-rendering this marker after intrinsic image sizing makes Web scroll-view
      // recalculate its content range when an image resolves asynchronously.
      this.setData({ layoutRevision: this.data.layoutRevision + 1 })
    },
    onTouchStart () {
      this.setData({ dragging: true })
    },
    onTouchMove () {},
    onTouchEnd () {
      this.setData({ dragging: false })
    },
    openCart () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/cart/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-video": "../../components/product-video"
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>

--- product-video.mpx ---
<template>
  <view class="product-video">
    <video
      id="product-video-{{product.id}}"
      class="video"
      src="{{product.video}}"
      autoplay="{{autoplay}}"
      muted="{{muted}}"
      playsinline
      controls
      show-center-play-btn
      show-mute-btn
      enable-play-gesture
      bindtap="onVideoTap"
      bindtimeupdate="onTimeUpdate"
      bindloadedmetadata="onLoadedMetadata"
      binderror="onVideoError"
    />
    <text>{{progress}} / {{duration}}</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: { type: Object, value: () => ({}) }
  },
  data: {
    progress: 0,
    duration: 0,
    autoplay: true,
    // Mobile browsers permit autoplay reliably when the video starts muted.
    muted: true
  },
  methods: {
    onTimeUpdate (event) {
      this.setData({
        progress: event.detail.currentTime,
        duration: event.detail.duration
      })
    },
    onLoadedMetadata (event) {
      this.videoSize = `${event.detail.width}x${event.detail.height}`
    },
    onVideoTap (event) {
      // A tap is a user gesture: it can start playback and enable audio.
      this.setData({ muted: false })
      const context = mpx.createVideoContext(event.currentTarget.id, this)
      context.play()
    },
    onVideoError () {}
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>
.product-video { width: 100%; }
.video { display: block; width: 100%; }
</style>
